issues.description: Parameter type annotation mismatch for the y_states argument of build_msd_circ: the problem statement specifies y_states: tuple[int] while both the template and the provided solution use y_states: list[int]. This inconsistency could confuse students about the expected container type for resource-state qubit indices and may lead to minor type hinting/typing confusion when following examples or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type annotation for y_states consistent across all artifacts. Either change the problem statement to specify y_states: list[int] (preferred, since template/solution use lists) or update the template and solution signatures to accept tuple[int]. Also update any example usages and documentation to use the chosen container type so students have a single clear expectation.
